description.value: A small, rustic lakefront campground in the Skagit Valley with a mountain backdrop, offering trout fishing, swimming, and quiet lake-edge camping; access involves several kilometres of gravel on Silver Skagit Road, and bears are very active.

raw_osm.name: Silver Lake Provinical Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Silver Lake Park is an active provincial campground in the Skagit Valley with 25 rustic campsites; the operator and website URL both match the OSM record. The website describes the experience as 'rustic camping' with no mention of showers, potable water, hiker/biker-specific sites, or most other amenities, leaving most optional fields as null. The cycling section on the website was truncated mid-sentence ('bicycles with electric assist moto...'), so e-bike policy is unresolvable; the OSM name also contains a spelling error ('Provinical' instead of 'Provincial') noted as a concern.
concerns: OSM name contains a spelling error: 'Provinical' should be 'Provincial' — this may indicate a data-entry issue in OSM worth correcting upstream.

The cycling section on the website was truncated mid-sentence ('Please note that bicycles with electric assist moto...'), so any e-bike restrictions or allowances cannot be determined from available evidence.
OSM tag 'opening_hours:covid19=off' is a legacy COVID-era closure tag; the website content appears current and active, suggesting this tag is outdated and no longer reflects park status.
No address or phone number is present in the OSM record; general BC Parks contact info (1-800-689-9025, parkinfo@gov.bc.ca) is available via the /contact/ page but is not park-specific.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks provincial campground with a confirmed website, 25 campsites, and a viable location for touring cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley / Skagit Valley corridor near Hope.
